title: [BUG] Pilot can falsely complete embodied tasks without execution evidence
real_pain_point: The planner can self-declare task completion even when no physical action or execution receipt exists; the proposed acceptance criteria require independent verification and exact evidence identifiers.

titmas_reusable_components.bounded_role: execution receipt packaging and offline structure/digest/chain verification
replay-oriented audit of missing-action and stale-observation traces

why_accept: A small fixture or test matrix for missing actions, failed actions, stale observations, and alternate successful traces closely matches the published acceptance criteria.
why_reject: The Issue is assigned to its author, preferred architecture is unresolved, repository-specific RTDL semantics may not match TITMAS artifacts, and no help-wanted signal was observed.
minimum_contribution: Locally map one reported failed trace and one successful trace into a bounded evidence-gap test proposal without changing the upstream repository.
key_risks: assigned internal work may already be underway
robotics domain semantics may exceed current TITMAS evidence adapters
no maintainer interest or contribution permission established
human_or_agent_decisions_required: whether to perform a local repository architecture audit
whether any later comment or PR is worth a new independent quorum
